hypothesis: Train complete linked shortest routes and all competitors toward near-solved goals, rather than isolated parent stars, to connect distant choices with goal-entry decisions.
supervision: Reuse fixed_goal.shortest_paths and exact common-left action-preserving translation to construct paths to absolute nearby goals. Admit a route only when every parent/candidate-to-goal relation is outside all protected sets. Use every route parent with its complete legal candidate star in a common batch; no oracle or route retrieval at inference.
comparison: Same step-1000 Q and Adam, learning rate, Huber and rank weights, restoration replay, validation/retention selection and update budget as near_goal_low_lr. Near-goal stars are grouped into complete routes from a fixed admissible training pool. Actual star counts, pool acceptance and goal coverage must be reported; this changes sampling and repeated exposure, not only grouping.
scope: One bounded route-supervision check from step 1000. Previously inspected evaluation sets remain regression evidence; no automatic extension or adoption.
